name.full: Markstrata - markdown for SharePoint and Teams

description.short: Read markdown from this team's files, themed and rendered properly.
description.full:
Markstrata renders markdown files the way you wrote them. Point a tab at a .md file in this team's Files and it is rendered with a table of contents, working code blocks with syntax highlighting, GitHub alerts and Obsidian callouts, Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX maths and sortable tables, in a theme modelled on GitHub, Obsidian or VS Code, in light or dark.

A channel's Files are a SharePoint document library, so the documents are the ones already there. Nothing is copied anywhere and nothing leaves your tenant: the tab reads the file with your own signed-in session. Links between markdown documents open in the tab rather than downloading the file, so a folder of documentation reads as a set rather than as files.
